description:
*“In patients, out troublemakers.”*

Lee Si-jin, determined to save up a hundred million won and start a new life abroad, goes to an employment agency to apply for a hostess job in drag. But when he comes to his senses, he realizes he has signed a work contract for an oriental medicine clinic instead…?!
